Campustown Commons
$1,599/mo 1 bed. 1 bath. 301 E Daniel St, Champaign IL 61820
Washer and dryer hookups only. Dishwasher. Street parking permits $120 per semester.
Utilities: water, sewer, trash billed by RUBS, about $48 per quarter. Tenant pays electric.
Pets: No pets. Built 2008. Move-in total $3,600.
